question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fatigued
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fatigued"** means extremely tired or exhausted. (थका हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** After running the marathon, he was completely fatigued and needed to rest.
 
 
 
• **"Tired"** refers to feeling in need of rest or sleep due to physical or mental exertion. (थका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** She felt tired after working for long hours without a break.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Furious** (क्रोधित): Extremely angry.

 
 
• **Example:** She was furious when she found out that her brother had broken her favorite vase.
 
 
 
• **Tricky** (कठिन): Something that is difficult to deal with or manage.
 
 
• **Example:** Solving the puzzle was tricky and took him several hours.
 
 
 
• **Famous** (प्रसिद्ध): Known about by many people.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor became famous after his blockbuster movie was released.
